orders_refs_check.name: orders_refs_check
orders_refs_check.value:
("orders"."kind" = 'credit_pack' and "orders"."pack_id" is not null)
        or ("orders"."kind" in ('subscription', 'upgrade') and "orders"."plan_id" is not null and "orders"."months" is not null)

payment_methods_amount_range_check.name: payment_methods_amount_range_check
payment_methods_amount_range_check.value:
("payment_methods"."min_amount_minor" is null or "payment_methods"."min_amount_minor" >= 0)
        and ("payment_methods"."max_amount_minor" is null or "payment_methods"."max_amount_minor" >= 0)
        and ("payment_methods"."min_amount_minor" is null or "payment_methods"."max_amount_minor" is null or "payment_methods"."max_amount_minor" >= "payment_methods"."min_amount_minor")

deal_targets_target_check.name: deal_targets_target_check
deal_targets_target_check.value:
num_nonnulls("deal_targets"."target_user_id", "deal_targets"."target_org_id", "deal_targets"."referral_code_id", "deal_targets"."email_domain") = 1
        and (
          ("deal_targets"."target_kind" = 'user' and "deal_targets"."target_user_id" is not null)
          or ("deal_targets"."target_kind" = 'organization' and "deal_targets"."target_org_id" is not null)
          or ("deal_targets"."target_kind" = 'referral_code' and "deal_targets"."referral_code_id" is not null)
          or ("deal_targets"."target_kind" = 'email_domain' and "deal_targets"."email_domain" is not null)
        )

deals_period_check.name: deals_period_check
deals_period_check.value: "deals"."starts_at" is null or "deals"."ends_at" is null or "deals"."ends_at" > "deals"."starts_at"

experiments_variants_check.name: experiments_variants_check
experiments_variants_check.value: case when jsonb_typeof("experiments"."variants") = 'array' then jsonb_array_length("experiments"."variants") between 2 and 10 else false end

experiments_period_check.name: experiments_period_check
experiments_period_check.value: "experiments"."started_at" is null or "experiments"."ended_at" is null or "experiments"."ended_at" >= "experiments"."started_at"

plans_features_check.name: plans_features_check
plans_features_check.value: case when jsonb_typeof("plans"."features") = 'array' then jsonb_array_length("plans"."features") <= 30 else false end

plans_available_window_check.name: plans_available_window_check
plans_available_window_check.value: "plans"."available_from" is null or "plans"."available_until" is null or "plans"."available_from" < "plans"."available_until"

coupons_currency_check.name: coupons_currency_check
coupons_currency_check.value: ("coupons"."kind" = 'fixed') = ("coupons"."currency" is not null) and ("coupons"."currency" is null or "coupons"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

coupons_period_check.name: coupons_period_check
coupons_period_check.value: "coupons"."starts_at" is null or "coupons"."ends_at" is null or "coupons"."ends_at" > "coupons"."starts_at"

promotions_currency_check.name: promotions_currency_check
promotions_currency_check.value: ("promotions"."kind" = 'fixed') = ("promotions"."currency" is not null) and ("promotions"."currency" is null or "promotions"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

promotions_period_check.name: promotions_period_check
promotions_period_check.value: "promotions"."starts_at" is null or "promotions"."ends_at" is null or "promotions"."ends_at" > "promotions"."starts_at"

payout_methods_amount_range_check.name: payout_methods_amount_range_check
payout_methods_amount_range_check.value:
("payout_methods"."min_amount_minor" is null or "payout_methods"."min_amount_minor" >= 0)
        and ("payout_methods"."max_amount_minor" is null or "payout_methods"."max_amount_minor" >= 0)
        and ("payout_methods"."min_amount_minor" is null or "payout_methods"."max_amount_minor" is null or "payout_methods"."max_amount_minor" >= "payout_methods"."min_amount_minor")

reward_rules_limits_check.name: reward_rules_limits_check
reward_rules_limits_check.value:
("reward_rules"."max_per_referrer_per_day" is null or "reward_rules"."max_per_referrer_per_day" > 0)
        and ("reward_rules"."max_per_referrer_total" is null or "reward_rules"."max_per_referrer_total" > 0)
        and ("reward_rules"."min_order_minor" is null or "reward_rules"."min_order_minor" >= 0)
        and ("reward_rules"."max_renewals" is null or "reward_rules"."max_renewals" > 0)

reward_rules_period_check.name: reward_rules_period_check
reward_rules_period_check.value: "reward_rules"."valid_from" is null or "reward_rules"."valid_to" is null or "reward_rules"."valid_to" > "reward_rules"."valid_from"

withdrawal_requests_paid_check.name: withdrawal_requests_paid_check
withdrawal_requests_paid_check.value: "withdrawal_requests"."status" <> 'paid' or ("withdrawal_requests"."transfer_reference" is not null and "withdrawal_requests"."paid_at" is not null)

users_pending_anonymization_idx.name: users_pending_anonymization_idx
users_pending_anonymization_idx.where: "users"."deleted_at" is not null and "users"."anonymized_at" is null

users_phone_verified_needs_phone_check.name: users_phone_verified_needs_phone_check
users_phone_verified_needs_phone_check.value: "users"."phone_verified_at" is null or "users"."phone" is not null
